input.contents:
/*
    STA_Vehicle: mapping tên xe trạm cân -> TPT_Vehicle.VehicleID
    STA_Vehicle.id = TPT_Vehicle.VehicleID
    Nhiều STA_Vehicle.ten có thể cùng 1 id
*/

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Vehicle_GET]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_GET]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_GET]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Select
        STA_Vehicle.ten,
        STA_Vehicle.id
    From
        STA_Vehicle
    Where
        STA_Vehicle.ten = @ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Vehicle_GETALL]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_GETALL]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_GETALL]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Select
        STA_Vehicle.ten,
        STA_Vehicle.id
    From
        STA_Vehicle
    Order By
        STA_Vehicle.ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Vehicle_SEARCH]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_SEARCH]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_SEARCH]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Select
        STA_Vehicle.ten,
        STA_Vehicle.id,
        TPT_Vehicle.VehicleCode,
        TPT_Vehicle.VehicleCode2,
        TPT_Vehicle.VehicleName
    From
        STA_Vehicle
        Left Join TPT_Vehicle On TPT_Vehicle.VehicleID = STA_Vehicle.id
    Order By
        STA_Vehicle.ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Vehicle_ADD]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_ADD]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_ADD]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250),
    @id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Insert Into STA_Vehicle (
        ten,
        id
    )
    Values (
        @ten,
        @id
    )
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Vehicle_EDIT]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_EDIT]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_EDIT]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250),
    @id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Update
        STA_Vehicle
    Set
        id = @id
    Where
        ten = @ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Vehicle_DELETE]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_DELETE]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Vehicle_DELETE]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Delete From
        STA_Vehicle
    Where
        ten = @ten
END
GO

    Cấu hình lưới STA_Vehicle

### SQL (`hos/Database/sta-mapping`)
| File | Mục đích |
|------|----------|
| `STA_Vehicle.sql` | Store GET/GETALL/SEARCH/ADD/EDIT/DELETE (SEARCH join `TPT_Vehicle`) |
| `STA_Vehicle_GridColumn.sql` | Cột lưới: `ten`, `id` |
| `sta-vehicle.sql` | Ghi chú mapping |

### Object / Form
- `StationObject/STA_Vehicle.cs` (+ Base sẵn có)
- `frmSTAVehicle` — giống `frmSTAItem`:
  - Lookup xe qua `TPT_VehicleService`
  - Chuột phải **Chọn xe** (F7) → `frmVehicleSelect`
  - Dòng Modified tô hồng
  - Quyền: `STA_Vehicle_Add/Edit/Delete/View`

### Việc cần làm trên DB
Chạy lần lượt:
1. `STA_Vehicle.sql`
2. `STA_Vehicle_GridColumn.sql`

### Mở form
```csharp
StationManager.Declaration.frmSTAVehicle.Instance.Run(false);
```

function Fix-DoubleNewlines($path) {
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
  $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
  # Normalize: if every line is blank-separated, collapse \r\n\r\n to \r\n (but keep intentional blank lines as single)
  # Pattern: content has \r\n\r\n between EVERY line including code lines
  # Strategy: replace all \r\n\r\n with \r\n first, then restore intentional double blanks for regions by matching frmSTAItem style via rewrite
  $fixed = $text -replace "`r`n`r`n", "`r`n"
  $fixed = $fixed -replace "`n`n", "`n"
  # Ensure CRLF
  $fixed = $fixed -replace "`r`n", "`n" -replace "`n", "`r`n"
  $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $fixed, $utf8NoBom)
  Write-Output "$path -> $((Get-Content -LiteralPath $path).Count) lines"
}
